values: Vanishing of the cellularization map for non-p-nilpotent component groups — Alec Kriebel, v1.0.0, 2026-10-17. Problem 30006658 / OWR-14299915-021: affirmative answer to Greenlees Question 2.2, OWR 9/2026 p.594. For every compact Lie group with non-p-nilpotent component group and every characteristic-p field, the completed loop-chain cellularization map is zero on all homotopy groups. Four-page analytic research note; classical inputs credited; bounded priority audit. Extensive AI use; unrefereed, no external human peer review or formal proof-assistant certification. Independent algebra/topology audits and two fresh sequential package reviews found no remaining actionable issues. TeX source and exact bounded convention checks included. PR: https://github.com/AlecKriebel/Math/pull/1102 ; files: https://zenodo.org/records/23439582 .
3100034 / AMR-030-0034 — Cooper's perfectly k-symmetric permutations: exact equal counts of all subsequence patterns; https://people.math.sc.edu/cooper/combprob.html

Gal Beniamini, Nir Lavee and Nati Linial, How Balanced Can Permutations Be?, Combinatorica 45, article 9 (2025), published online 2 January 2025. Full finite classification for integers n>=k>=1: k=1 all n; k=2 iff n mod4 is0 or1; k=3 iff n mod36 is0,1,9,20,28,29; k>=4 none. Thus infinitely many lengths for each k<=3 and none for k>=4. Patterns use arbitrary increasing index sets, not consecutive substrings. Theorems1–2 and Theorem5; exceptional19 witnesses in AppendixA Table1. Existing published resolution, not a new project theorem or upload. Audited in PR1194: https://github.com/AlecKriebel/Math/pull/1194 .
